items.headline: $CYS Bridge Exploit Minted 10M Tokens on BNB
items.summary: The $CYS bridge exploit let an attacker mint 10 million tokens on BNB Chain, with PeckShield tracing ~$744K to Tornado Cash. Transfers resumed by Oct. 28.

items.headline: Top $HYPE Whale Adds Millions to Dodge Liquidation
items.summary: A major $HYPE holder injected millions in USDC margin to stave off liquidation on a sizable leveraged position. Whales are defending big Hyperliquid bets.

items.headline: $FKEY Blames Unpatched Tool for $1.6M Hack
items.summary: Fluidkey's post-mortem says stolen session tokens let an attacker stage transfers that users' apps signed, draining $1.6M. Personal data and viewing keys were also exposed.

items.headline: MUFG Tests $CC for Intraday JGB Repo Funding
items.summary: MUFG detailed a Canton Network test for intraday JGB repo funding, exploring digital deposits and stablecoins while preserving bonds' legal status. Big TradFi validation for $CC.

items.headline: $AAVE USDC Borrow Cap Nears Limit, $190M Left
items.summary: $AAVE's $4B USDC borrow cap is nearly maxed out, leaving roughly $190M available for withdrawals. A liquidity squeeze worth watching for DeFi users.
